project.name: Roomr
project.title: How many calls and rooms a Roomr node handles.
project.lead: Roomr on two dedicated cores, the spec's capacity bar, driven by SIPp from a second server.

benchmarks.title: Call setup at a 2 s hold

narrative.what: Inbound calls answered by an app over the control stream, each held 2 s.
narrative.why: Every call pays this cost; when it saturates, callers wait or fail.
narrative.how: SIPp ramps INVITEs from 10 to 300 calls/s, 10 more every minute, each call held 2 s, so about twice the rate is mixing audio at once. It stops at the first step where p99 INVITE-to-200 reaches 200 ms or failed calls reach 0.1%.

narrative.what: Rooms of one G.711 caller and one app participant, mixing audio both ways.
narrative.how: SIPp holds about 200 concurrent rooms (3.34 calls/s, 60 s each, PCMU RTP) for six hours. After a 30-minute warm-up, memory may grow at most 5 MB/h.
